items.title: Data pipeline reliability toolkit
items.summary: Package the retry-with-backoff pattern, idempotency-key discipline, and safe API-key rotation into one reusable reliability layer for data pipelines.
items.rationale: All three showed up solving the same underlying problem -- failures and retries in long-running pipelines -- from three different angles.

items.title: Bioinformatics plotting library with sane defaults
items.summary: A small plotting package that bakes in the Manhattan-plot layout and a color-blind-safe palette as defaults, so neither has to be re-derived per project.
items.rationale: Both are visualization decisions that get re-solved from scratch on nearly every project that needs them.

items.title: "Don't ship this mistake" checklist product
items.summary: A short, paid pre-launch checklist product (client-side-only validation, test-set leakage, hyperparameter tuning against the test set) aimed at small teams without a dedicated reviewer.
items.rationale: Speculative -- these precautions are real and recurring, but it's unclear anyone would pay for a checklist rather than just writing one down themselves.
